body: New task: research/TASK_M4.md - THE POST-FIGHT READ, THE VISUAL LANGUAGE. Model: top tier, effort medium, Fast off. The screen a bout ends on: the round-by-round card in all three styles the engine really runs (ten-point-must, points, ippon), the decision stamp family including the SPLIT and MAJORITY the sim cannot yet emit, your M3 range card slotted in, and the honest empties. Prefix files m4_, boards to DesignLibrary/screens/post_fight/. IMPORTANT: no judges as characters - no names, portraits or per-judge cards - until John's J1 study rules whether judges are people; just leave room for one. Gold x1 and it belongs to the verdict line. Do not extend the AAA profile pack: it landed as REFERENCE only (d3c9b2b), not adopted.
